description: This file is a PHP web page script that generates a troubleshooting logs interface for a network or gateway device. It includes headers, navigation, JavaScript for dynamic log viewing, and HTML for displaying logs of different types (system, event, firewall) over various time frames.

methods.name: adjust_acs_tb
methods.description: Adjusts the table headers and assigns header IDs based on provided array, ensuring accessibility and proper labeling of table columns.

methods.name: ajaxDo
methods.description: Performs AJAX request to fetch logs data based on mode and time frame, updates the corresponding table, and manages pagination and print/download button states.
